summary: E2E READ-ONLY verification of three fixes on live-prod-wired preview. (1) Merchant-pool sweep — skipped per instructions. (2) Transaction Details drawer for auto-converted payments: fully verified for tx 944 (ETH $50.42) and tx 941 (BTC $27.73). Backend GET /api/wallet/transaction/{id}?company_id=1 returns the full auto_convert block including payout_offchain=true, payout_ref='Off-chain transfer 410062742674' / '…410024329946', payout_tx_hash=null, deposit_tx_hash present but distinct. POST /api/wallet/getAllTransactions carries the same auto_convert on each row (data.customers_transactions[]). UI drawer: tx-modal-status='Settled\nConverted'; tx-payout-amount-row / tx-payout-amount = '48.91 USDT (TRC20)' and '27.01 USDT (TRC20)'; tx-payout-hash-row[data-payout='offchain'] with heading 'Payout reference (USDT · TRC20, exchange-internal transfer)' and hint 'Your TRC20 payout address is hosted by the same exchange we convert on, so the USDT was credited instantly as an internal transfer — no blockchain transaction exists for this leg.'; tx-copy-outgoing-hash clipboard = exactly 'Off-chain transfer 410062742674' / '…410024329946'; admin deposit hash 0xef751a14…5482f1 is NOT rendered in the outgoing/payout row; incoming ETH hash 0x01e9be6f57a826… and BTC hash a0bf102798c7a22f… are rendered in the Incoming Transaction ID input; no raw i18n keys leak. Non-converted regression (tx 937 Settled ETH direct-settlement): drawer renders both Incoming Transaction ID (0xd861d9de…) and Outgoing Transaction ID (0x8e25d80f…) plus 'View on Explorer' button, and does NOT render 'Paid out as' or tx-payout-hash-row — no regression. (3) Hosted checkout intermediate statuses via mocked verifyCryptoPayment: full transition sequence captured (LTC default coin was auto-selected on /pay?d=rNtQRX): t=0ms state=pending stage=none (waiting), t=7500ms state=confirming stage=mempool (verify call #3, unconfirmed=true), t=15500ms state=confirming stage=confirming (verify call #5, txId present, no unconfirmed flag), t=23000ms clean-checkout-success-icon visible. Both intermediate stages rendered — no jump from waiting straight to confirmed. addPayment was intercepted so no pool address was reserved; SSE stream aborted. Regression reload with NO mocks: /pay?d=rNtQRX renders coin picker, $15.00 USD, brand 'Pay The Dev Store', 'Identity verified', no console/page errors, no horizontal overflow at 390×844.
critical_code_review_comments: AutoConvertPayoutRow (offchain branch) renders the Off-chain reference visually and copies it to clipboard, but the reference text is not part of the row's innerText because it lives inside a copy-input value attribute; a screen reader will read the surrounding label ('Payout reference (USDT · TRC20, exchange-internal transfer)') and the hint, but not the reference itself. Consider adding an aria-label='Off-chain transfer 410062742674' on the input or a visually-hidden span, so assistive tech announces the identifier.

For non-converted transactions the drawer's Incoming/Outgoing hash rows use <input value='…'>. Hash values are not in the DOM innerText — this makes automated text-based scraping brittle. Fine as-is, but consider also rendering the hash as text-body for copy-linkers.

Verify-poll cadence during checkout (waiting -> mempool observed at t≈7.5s, confirming at t≈15.5s, confirmed at t≈23s → ~7-8 s per transition) is comfortable; the >=4 s MIN_DETECTED_DWELL_MS is respected. No action needed.

Default coin on /pay?d=rNtQRX is LTC; there is no data-testid='clean-checkout-coin-ETH' rendered until the dropdown/list is expanded. The review request assumed ETH testid was directly clickable — clarify whether coin selection uses a MUI Select or chip list, and expose data-testid='clean-checkout-coin-<SYM>' for each option consistently.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://speedup-check.preview.emergentagent.com. Transaction Details drawer is a MuiDrawer (NOT MuiDialog) — scope with '.MuiDrawer-root' or just use page-level data-testid selectors (they are unique). tx-payout-hash-row exposes data-payout='onchain|offchain|pending|failed'. Non-converted drawers use <input value='<hash>'> so innerText is empty; read the input value instead. For /pay?d=rNtQRX, the DEFAULT coin is LTC — data-testid='clean-checkout-coin-ETH' is not present until the coin dropdown is opened. Mocked verify sequence pattern (waiting x2 → pending+unconfirmed x2 → pending+txId x2 → confirmed) transitions attribute pay-status-strip[data-detect-stage] through none → mempool → confirming → success with total ~23 s elapsed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All three fixes verified end-to-end. The two review items that initially looked like failures (a) tx testids 'NOT FOUND' when scoped to '.MuiDialog-root' and (b) empty container_text on non-converted rows both turned out to be selector-scoping artifacts of my test script (drawer is MuiDrawer; hash values live in input.value not innerText), NOT product bugs — the visual + backend evidence confirms correct rendering.
